blocks.zh: Section 1: Rapid Microbial Test Methods & Method Suitability — 快速微生物試驗方法與方法適用性
blocks.en: Section 1: Rapid Microbial Test Methods & Method Suitability

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 了解不適用 ⟨71⟩ 傳統無菌試驗放行的三大情境：樣品量限制、偵測極限門檻、微生物涵蓋範圍
blocks.en: Understand the three situations in which release by the traditional ⟨71⟩ sterility test is unsuitable: sample volume limitations, limit-of-detection thresholds, and breadth of microbial coverage

blocks.zh: 掌握六種候選快速微生物試驗（RMT）技術的原理與適用場景
blocks.en: Know the principles and applicable scenarios of the six candidate rapid microbial test (RMT) technologies

blocks.zh: 理解 ATP 生物冷光法的雙模式運作（直接檢測 vs. 預增殖後檢測）
blocks.en: Understand the two operating modes of ATP bioluminescence (direct detection vs. detection after pre-incubation)

blocks.zh: 認識核酸擴增法（PCR）用於無菌放行的獨特優勢與限制
blocks.en: Recognize the unique advantages and limitations of nucleic acid amplification (PCR) for sterility release

blocks.zh: 掌握方法適用性測試（Method Suitability Testing）的核心要求
blocks.en: Know the core requirements of method suitability testing

blocks.zh: 理解非生長型訊號（基因組拷貝數、ATP、螢光標記）如何影響 LOD 定義與結果判讀
blocks.en: Understand how non-growth-based signals (genome copy number, ATP, fluorescent labeling) affect the definition of LOD and the interpretation of results

blocks.zh: Situations When ⟨71⟩ Is Unsuitable for Product Release Testing — ⟨71⟩ 不適用的情境
blocks.en: Situations When ⟨71⟩ Is Unsuitable for Product Release Testing

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：取樣量的兩難困境
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Sampling Dilemma

blocks.zh: 這段揭示了短效期產品無菌試驗的根本矛盾：
blocks.en: This passage reveals the fundamental contradiction in sterility testing of short-shelf-life products:

blocks.zh: 傳統藥品：40,000 瓶批次中取 40 瓶（0.1%）— 損失微不足道
blocks.en: Conventional drugs: 40 vials taken from a 40,000-vial batch (0.1%) - the loss is negligible

blocks.zh: 細胞治療：10 袋批次中要取 4 袋的 20 mL（消耗 40%！）— 病人可能因此少拿到一半的治療劑量
blocks.en: Cell therapy: 4 bags (20 mL) taken from a 10-bag batch (40% consumed!) - patients may receive only half of their therapeutic dose as a result

blocks.zh: 這就是為什麼歐洲藥典（EP 2.6.27）對細胞製品採取了更務實的取樣策略：10–1000 mL 製品只取總量的 1%，1–10 mL 製品只取 0.1 mL，<1 mL 的製品甚至不測試。
blocks.en: This is why the European Pharmacopoeia (EP 2.6.27) takes a more pragmatic sampling approach for cell-based products: for 10–1000 mL products, only 1% of the total volume is sampled; for 1–10 mL products, only 0.1 mL; and products of <1 mL are not even tested.

blocks.zh: CDMO 啟示：接受細胞治療充填訂單時，必須在製程設計階段就規劃好取樣策略，確保留有足夠的治療劑量。
blocks.en: Implication for CDMOs: when you accept an order to fill a cell therapy product, you must plan the sampling strategy at the process design stage to ensure that enough therapeutic dose remains.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：稀世珠寶的品質檢測
blocks.en: Analogy: Quality Testing of Rare Jewels

blocks.zh: 想像你是珠寶鑑定師。鑑定一批 10,000 顆工業鑽石的純度，你可以隨便抽 40 顆做破壞性測試 — 損失不到 0.5%。
blocks.en: Imagine you are a gemologist. To assess the purity of a batch of 10,000 industrial diamonds, you can pull 40 at random for destructive testing - a loss of less than 0.5%.

blocks.zh: 但如果客戶送來的是 10 顆獨一無二的帝王祖母綠呢？你不能拿走 4 顆去切開檢驗！你需要一種非破壞性的快速檢測方法 — 比如 X 光螢光光譜儀 — 即使它的精確度不如破壞性測試，但至少不會毀掉客戶的寶石。
blocks.en: But what if the client sends 10 one-of-a-kind imperial emeralds? You cannot take 4 of them away and cut them open for inspection! You need a rapid, non-destructive test method - such as an X-ray fluorescence spectrometer - which may be less precise than destructive testing but at least will not ruin the client's gemstones.

blocks.zh: RMT 對短效期產品的角色就像非破壞性檢測對珍稀寶石的角色：在有限的樣品量中盡可能獲得最好的結果。
blocks.en: The role of RMT for short-shelf-life products is like the role of non-destructive testing for rare gemstones: getting the best possible result from a limited sample volume.

blocks.zh: 統計解讀：Table 3 & Table 4 的含義
blocks.en: Statistical Interpretation: What Tables 3 & 4 Mean

blocks.zh: 無菌試驗的通過機率公式：P(pass) = qn
blocks.en: The probability of passing a sterility test is given by: P(pass) = qn

blocks.zh: 其中 q = 1 - p（p 為污染率），n = 取樣數
blocks.en: where q = 1 - p (p is the contamination rate) and n = the number of units sampled

blocks.zh: 關鍵啟示：
blocks.en: Key takeaways:

blocks.zh: 批次有 1% 污染率時，20 瓶取樣仍有 82% 機率通過無菌試驗 — 這說明傳統試驗的統計偵測力很弱
blocks.en: With a batch contamination rate of 1%, sampling 20 vials still gives an 82% chance of passing the sterility test - showing that the statistical detection power of the traditional test is weak

blocks.zh: CSP 只取 6 瓶時，即使 10% 污染率也有 53% 機率通過 — 近乎擲硬幣
blocks.en: When a CSP is sampled at only 6 vials, even a 10% contamination rate has a 53% chance of passing - close to a coin toss

blocks.zh: 取樣數從 20 降到 6 時，偵測力大幅下降
blocks.en: When the sample number drops from 20 to 6, detection power falls sharply

blocks.zh: 結論：無菌試驗不能靠統計取樣來保證無菌性 — 它必須搭配嚴格的製程控制（GMP）和環境監控（EM）。
blocks.en: Conclusion: a sterility test cannot assure sterility through statistical sampling - it must be combined with strict process control (GMP) and environmental monitoring (EM).

blocks.zh: 重點提示：LOD ≠ 1 cfu 不代表不合格
blocks.en: Key Point: An LOD above 1 cfu Does Not Mean Failure

blocks.zh: USP 在此明確指出：要求所有 RMT 技術都達到 1 cfu 的偵測極限是不切實際的門檻（unrealistic barrier of entry）。這是一個重要的監管訊號：
blocks.en: USP states explicitly that requiring all RMT technologies to reach a detection limit of 1 cfu is an unrealistic barrier of entry. This is an important regulatory signal:

blocks.zh: 傳統 ⟨71⟩ 的 LOD 1–3 cfu 依賴的是微生物在培養基中的增殖放大（cultural enrichment）
blocks.en: The 1–3 cfu LOD of the traditional ⟨71⟩ relies on multiplication of microorganisms in the culture medium (cultural enrichment)

blocks.zh: 非生長型訊號（ATP、DNA/RNA、螢光標記）沒有這種天然放大機制，因此 LOD 天生就會較高
blocks.en: Non-growth-based signals (ATP, DNA/RNA, fluorescent labeling) have no such natural amplification mechanism, so their LOD is inherently higher

blocks.zh: 重點不在於 LOD 是否等於 1 cfu，而在於整體風險評估中，RMT 是否能在給藥前提供有意義的安全資訊
blocks.en: The point is not whether the LOD equals 1 cfu, but whether, within the overall risk assessment, the RMT can provide meaningful safety information before administration

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 接到一批 CAR-T 產品訂單，批量為 5 袋、每袋 50 mL。按 ⟨71⟩ 的取樣要求，需要消耗多少比例的產品？按 EP 2.6.27 的 1% 規則呢？
blocks.en: Your CDMO receives an order for a batch of CAR-T product, with a batch size of 5 bags of 50 mL each. What proportion of the product would be consumed under the ⟨71⟩ sampling requirements? What about under the 1% rule of EP 2.6.27?

blocks.zh: Table 3 顯示即使 5% 污染率仍有 36% 機率通過 20 瓶取樣。如果你是 QA 主管，這對你的放行決策邏輯意味著什麼？
blocks.en: Table 3 shows that even at a 5% contamination rate there is still a 36% chance of passing when 20 vials are sampled. As the QA head, what does this mean for your release decision logic?

blocks.zh: 21 CFR 610.12 允許使用快速方法的 in-process testing 來取代最終產品無菌試驗。你認為需要什麼樣的驗證數據來支持這項策略？
blocks.en: 21 CFR 610.12 allows rapid in-process testing methods to replace the final-product sterility test. What validation data do you think would be needed to support this strategy?

blocks.zh: Rapid Microbial Test Methods for the Release of Sterile Short-Life Products — 短效期無菌產品的快速微生物試驗方法
blocks.en: Rapid Microbial Test Methods for the Release of Sterile Short-Life Products

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：六種偵探工具
blocks.en: Analogy: Six Detective Tools

blocks.zh: 想像你是一位偵探，需要在犯罪現場尋找嫌疑人留下的痕跡。六種 RMT 就像六種不同的鑑識工具：
blocks.en: Imagine you are a detective looking for traces left by a suspect at a crime scene. The six RMTs are like six different forensic tools:

blocks.zh: ATP 生物冷光 = 發光胺噴霧（Luminol）— 噴上去立刻發光，有反應就知道「有東西在這」，但不確定是什麼
blocks.en: ATP bioluminescence = luminol spray - it glows immediately when sprayed, so a reaction tells you "something is here", but not what it is

blocks.zh: 流式細胞儀 = 監視器錄影回放 — 可以看到誰進出，但需要先拉出特定時段的畫面
blocks.en: Flow cytometry = surveillance video playback - you can see who came and went, but you first have to pull up the footage for a specific time window

blocks.zh: 等溫微量熱法 = 紅外線熱感應 — 偵測有沒有活人躲在暗處散發體溫
blocks.en: Isothermal microcalorimetry = infrared heat sensing - detects whether a living person hiding in the dark is giving off body heat

blocks.zh: 核酸擴增（PCR） = DNA 鑑定 — 最精確但需要時間，而且連死人的 DNA 也會抓到
blocks.en: Nucleic acid amplification (PCR) = DNA identification - the most precise, but it takes time, and it also picks up the DNA of the dead

blocks.zh: 呼吸法 = 密封房間測 CO2 濃度 — 有人在裡面呼吸就會上升
blocks.en: Respiration methods = measuring CO2 in a sealed room - the level rises if someone is breathing inside

blocks.zh: 固相細胞分析 = 過濾後用紫外線掃描 — 快速但只適用於液體樣品
blocks.en: Solid-phase cytometry = filtering and then scanning with ultraviolet light - fast, but suitable only for liquid samples

blocks.zh: 重點提示：PCR 的四大獨特優勢
blocks.en: Key Point: The Four Unique Advantages of PCR

blocks.zh: 在所有 RMT 中，核酸擴增法（PCR）有四個其他方法無法比擬的優勢：
blocks.en: Among all RMTs, nucleic acid amplification (PCR) has four advantages that no other method can match:

blocks.zh: 近即時結果（2–4 h）— 能在大多數短效期產品給藥前完成
blocks.en: Near-real-time results (2–4 h) - can be completed before most short-shelf-life products are administered

blocks.zh: 偵測培養陰性病原體 — 有些微生物根本無法用傳統培養基生長（如 Tropheryma whipplei）
blocks.en: Detects culture-negative pathogens - some microorganisms cannot grow on conventional media at all (such as Tropheryma whipplei)

blocks.zh: 不受抗生素干擾 — 這對生產抗生素注射液的調配藥局特別重要
blocks.en: Not affected by antibiotics - particularly important for compounding pharmacies producing injectable antibiotic solutions

blocks.zh: 不受動物細胞裂解產物干擾 — 因為針對微生物特異性基因，細胞治療產品中的宿主細胞碎片不會造成假陽性
blocks.en: Not affected by animal cell lysates - because it targets microbe-specific genes, host cell debris in cell therapy products does not cause false positives

blocks.zh: 但也有致命限制：PCR 無法區分活菌與死菌。DNA 即使來自已死亡的微生物也會被擴增。需要搭配 EMA/PMA 前處理或使用 RNA（rRNA）作為靶標。
blocks.en: But there is also a critical limitation: PCR cannot distinguish live from dead organisms. DNA is amplified even if it comes from dead microorganisms. EMA/PMA pretreatment or the use of RNA (rRNA) as the target is needed.

blocks.zh: 深入理解：ATP 生物冷光法的雙模式
blocks.en: Deeper Understanding: The Two Modes of ATP Bioluminescence

blocks.zh: ATP 生物冷光法是最成熟、最廣泛使用的 RMT 技術之一。它有兩種運作模式：
blocks.en: ATP bioluminescence is one of the most mature and widely used RMT technologies. It has two operating modes:

blocks.zh: 直接檢測模式：30 分鐘出結果，但 LOD 只有約 103 cfu — 適用於需要即時篩檢的場景
blocks.en: Direct detection mode: result in 30 minutes, but the LOD is only about 103 cfu - suitable for scenarios requiring immediate screening

blocks.zh: 預增殖模式：先在培養基中培養 2–7 天至 ATP 門檻值再檢測，LOD 可達 1–10 cfu — 靈敏度大幅提升但速度犧牲
blocks.en: Pre-incubation mode: the sample is first incubated in culture medium for 2–7 days until an ATP threshold is reached and then tested, giving an LOD of 1–10 cfu - sensitivity is greatly improved but speed is sacrificed

blocks.zh: 有趣的數據：真菌的 ATP 含量（300–800 × 10−18 mol/cfu）是革蘭氏陰性菌（2–4 × 10−18 mol/cfu）的 100–200 倍。這意味著 ATP 法對黴菌的偵測靈敏度天生就比對細菌好得多。
blocks.en: An interesting figure: the ATP content of fungi (300–800 × 10−18 mol/cfu) is 100–200 times that of Gram-negative bacteria (2–4 × 10−18 mol/cfu). This means ATP methods are inherently much more sensitive for detecting molds than bacteria.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：固相細胞分析的限制
blocks.en: Key Point: Limitations of Solid-Phase Cytometry

blocks.zh: 固相細胞分析（SPC）是速度最快（2–3 h）且靈敏度最高（可達 1 cfu）的技術之一，看起來完美。但 USP 特別點出一個致命限制：大多數細胞治療產品無法過濾。
blocks.en: Solid-phase cytometry (SPC) is one of the fastest (2–3 h) and most sensitive (down to 1 cfu) technologies, and looks perfect. But USP points out one critical limitation: most cell therapy products cannot be filtered.

blocks.zh: SPC 依賴 0.45 μm 濾膜過濾來收集微生物。但細胞治療產品中的哺乳動物細胞（直徑 10–30 μm）會堵塞濾膜，使得過濾本身就不可行。這是一個很好的案例，說明為什麼技術選擇必須考慮產品特性（product attributes）。
blocks.en: SPC relies on 0.45 μm membrane filtration to collect microorganisms. But the mammalian cells in cell therapy products (10–30 μm in diameter) clog the membrane, so filtration itself is not feasible. This is a good example of why technology selection must take product attributes into account.

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 正在生產抗生素注射液的無菌調配。在六種 RMT 中，哪些技術可能會受到產品中抗生素殘留的干擾？哪種最不受影響？
blocks.en: Your CDMO is performing sterile compounding of injectable antibiotic solutions. Of the six RMTs, which technologies might be affected by antibiotic residues in the product? Which is least affected?

blocks.zh: 呼吸法（如自動血液培養系統）的「漸進式監控」（progressive monitoring）在 CDMO 的日常運作中如何實施？需要什麼樣的 SOP 和值班安排？
blocks.en: How is the "progressive monitoring" of respiration methods (such as automated blood culture systems) implemented in the day-to-day operation of a CDMO? What SOPs and on-call arrangements are needed?

blocks.zh: 如果你要向客戶推薦一種 RMT 用於 CAR-T 產品放行，考慮到產品不可過濾、含有大量宿主細胞碎片、且需要在 48 小時內出結果，你會選擇哪種技術？請說明排除其他技術的理由。
blocks.en: If you were to recommend an RMT to a client for release of a CAR-T product, given that the product cannot be filtered, contains a large amount of host cell debris, and needs a result within 48 hours, which technology would you choose? Explain your reasons for excluding the others.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：六種 RMT 技術的分類框架
blocks.en: Core Concept: A Classification Framework for the Six RMT Technologies

blocks.zh: USP ⟨1071⟩ 推薦的六種 RMT 技術可以從兩個維度進行分類：
blocks.en: The six RMT technologies recommended by USP ⟨1071⟩ can be classified along two dimensions:

blocks.zh: CDMO 選擇策略：生長依賴型更靈敏但較慢；非生長依賴型更快但 LOD 較差。選擇取決於產品的時間壓力。
blocks.en: CDMO selection strategy: growth-based methods are more sensitive but slower; non-growth-based methods are faster but have a poorer LOD. The choice depends on the time pressure of the product.

blocks.zh: Method Suitability Testing — 方法適用性測試
blocks.en: Method Suitability Testing

blocks.zh: 核心概念：方法適用性 vs. 方法驗證
blocks.en: Core Concept: Method Suitability vs. Method Validation

blocks.zh: 方法適用性測試（Method Suitability Testing）是 RMT 導入過程中最關鍵的驗證步驟。它的核心問題很簡單：
blocks.en: Method suitability testing is the most critical validation step in implementing an RMT. Its core question is simple:

blocks.zh: 「你的產品殘留物會不會干擾快速方法的訊號產生？」
blocks.en: "Will your product residues interfere with signal generation in the rapid method?"

blocks.zh: 傳統 ⟨71⟩：在產品殘留物存在下，接種 <100 cfu 的 USP 挑戰菌，看培養基中是否出現明顯生長
blocks.en: Traditional ⟨71⟩: inoculate <100 cfu of USP challenge organisms in the presence of product residues and check whether obvious growth appears in the medium

blocks.zh: RMT 方法：確認產品殘留物不會抑制酵素反應步驟（如 luciferase 的 ATP 偵測、PCR 的 DNA 擴增、螢光標記的染色反應）
blocks.en: RMT methods: confirm that product residues do not inhibit the enzymatic reaction steps (such as luciferase ATP detection, PCR DNA amplification, and the staining reaction of fluorescent labeling)

blocks.zh: 每一個產品都必須個別驗證 — 不能假設產品 A 通過了就代表產品 B 也沒問題。
blocks.en: Every product must be validated individually - you cannot assume that because product A passed, product B will be fine too.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：驗孕試紙與產品干擾
blocks.en: Analogy: Pregnancy Test Strips and Product Interference

blocks.zh: 方法適用性測試就像確認驗孕試紙在不同「環境」中是否還能正常運作。
blocks.en: Method suitability testing is like checking whether a pregnancy test strip still works properly in different "environments".

blocks.zh: 驗孕試紙設計來偵測 hCG 荷爾蒙。但如果尿液中有大量蛋白質、血液、或某些藥物成分，可能會干擾試紙的化學反應，導致假陰性（明明懷孕卻顯示沒有）或假陽性。
blocks.en: A pregnancy test strip is designed to detect the hormone hCG. But if the urine contains a lot of protein, blood, or certain drug components, they may interfere with the chemical reaction on the strip, causing a false negative (showing negative although the woman is pregnant) or a false positive.

blocks.zh: 方法適用性測試就是在模擬真實條件下，加入已知量的「目標物」（挑戰菌），確認你的檢測方法在產品殘留物存在的情況下仍然能正確偵測。如果產品含有抑菌劑、抗生素或高蛋白質，可能需要增加稀釋步驟或改用膜過濾法。
blocks.en: Method suitability testing adds a known quantity of the "target" (challenge organism) under simulated real conditions to confirm that your detection method can still detect it correctly in the presence of product residues. If the product contains bacteriostatic agents, antibiotics, or high levels of protein, you may need to add a dilution step or switch to membrane filtration.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：CDMO 的方法適用性策略
blocks.en: Key Point: Method Suitability Strategy for CDMOs

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，你可能同時生產數十種不同配方的產品。方法適用性策略建議：
blocks.en: In a CDMO environment you may manufacture dozens of products with different formulations at the same time. Suggested method suitability strategy:

blocks.zh: 產品分組（Grouping）：將成分相似的產品分為同一群組，選擇「最難偵測」的產品作為代表進行方法適用性測試
blocks.en: Grouping: place products with similar compositions in the same group and select the "hardest to detect" product as the representative for method suitability testing

blocks.zh: 最壞情境測試（Worst-case）：如果產品含有已知的 PCR 抑制劑（如肝素）或 ATP 干擾物（如螢光物質），必須在最壞條件下驗證
blocks.en: Worst-case testing: if a product contains known PCR inhibitors (such as heparin) or ATP interferents (such as fluorescent substances), validation must be performed under worst-case conditions

blocks.zh: 變更管控：配方或製程變更後必須重新評估方法適用性 — 新增的賦形劑可能改變干擾特性
blocks.en: Change control: method suitability must be reassessed after a formulation or process change - a newly added excipient may alter the interference profile

blocks.zh: 如果你選擇 ATP 生物冷光法作為 RMT，你的方法適用性測試需要驗證什麼？列出至少三個可能的干擾因子。
blocks.en: If you choose ATP bioluminescence as your RMT, what does your method suitability testing need to verify? List at least three possible interfering factors.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 USP 強調「results from testing actual samples may give results that are not equivalent to that using other technologies」？這對 RMT 結果的判定標準有什麼影響？
blocks.en: Why does USP emphasize that "results from testing actual samples may give results that are not equivalent to that using other technologies"? What impact does this have on the criteria for judging RMT results?

blocks.zh: 你的客戶要求你使用 PCR 法來放行他們的細胞治療產品。產品含有大量 DNA 酶（DNase）用於降解殘留的宿主 DNA。這會對 PCR 方法適用性測試帶來什麼挑戰？
blocks.en: Your client asks you to use PCR to release their cell therapy product. The product contains a large amount of DNase used to degrade residual host DNA. What challenges would this pose for PCR method suitability testing?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 傳統取樣策略不適用於短效期產品 — 細胞治療產品按 ⟨71⟩ 取樣可能消耗 40% 的批次產品，EP 2.6.27 提供了更務實的 1% 體積取樣規則
blocks.en: Traditional sampling strategies are not suitable for short-shelf-life products - sampling a cell therapy product per ⟨71⟩ could consume 40% of the batch, and EP 2.6.27 offers a more pragmatic 1% volume sampling rule

blocks.zh: 統計偵測力的先天限制 — 即使 1% 污染率，20 瓶取樣仍有 82% 機率通過無菌試驗；無菌保證不能只靠取樣
blocks.en: Inherent limits of statistical detection power - even at a 1% contamination rate, sampling 20 vials still gives an 82% chance of passing the sterility test; sterility assurance cannot rely on sampling alone

blocks.zh: LOD = 1 cfu 是不切實際的要求 — 非生長型訊號缺乏天然增殖放大機制，重點在於整體風險評估
blocks.en: An LOD of 1 cfu is an unrealistic requirement - non-growth-based signals lack natural amplification through multiplication, and the emphasis is on the overall risk assessment

blocks.zh: 六種 RMT 技術各有優劣 — ATP 最成熟、PCR 最快且不受抗生素干擾、呼吸法已有細胞治療的成功先例、SPC 最靈敏但不適用於不可過濾產品
blocks.en: The six RMT technologies each have strengths and weaknesses - ATP is the most mature, PCR is the fastest and unaffected by antibiotics, respiration methods have a successful precedent in cell therapy, and SPC is the most sensitive but unsuitable for non-filterable products

blocks.zh: 方法適用性測試不可省略 — 必須針對每個產品驗證殘留物不會干擾 RMT 的訊號產生機制
blocks.en: Method suitability testing cannot be omitted - for every product you must verify that residues do not interfere with the signal generation mechanism of the RMT

blocks.zh: RMT 結果不等同於 ⟨71⟩ 結果 — 不同訊號系統（cfu vs. genome equivalents vs. RLU）的結果不能直接比較
blocks.en: RMT results are not equivalent to ⟨71⟩ results - results from different signal systems (cfu vs. genome equivalents vs. RLU) cannot be compared directly
